title: PERSON WEY SABI BUILD SDR
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Wetin You Go Dey Do

Di person wey we go pick go dey in charge of:

  • Design and build solutions for radio wey software dey run (SDR),
  • Understand di SDR strategy well-well, and bring your own ideas,
  • Build and maintain di pipelines wey dey render, wey must perform well and no fit get delay pass wetin dem allow,
  • Work hand-in-hand wit di people wey dey design electronics,
  • Work hand-in-hand wit designers, product teams and systems engineers
  • Join hand for di decisions about architecture and di long-term technical strategy for di modem
  • Write technical documents wey get correct quality, and review code like senior person

Di Technical Skills Wey We Need

  • You must get strong foundation for SDR mathematics (linear algebra, transforms, projections)
  • Solid experience for building radio wey software dey run
  • Hands-on experience wit SDR and PCB
  • Experience to work wen time tight for real-time (frame budget, latency, di time from wen person move reach wen picture show for screen)
  • Programming languages: C / Rust / ASM

Na You Be Dis

  • 3 to 10 years experience for software development work, wey you focus well-well on SDR
  • You don show say you fit work on systems wey tough and wey important well-well
  • You sabi reason SDR matter well, and you fit understand big codebase wey don already dey ground
  • You dey careful well-well, you fit work on your own, you dey check every small detail, and e dey sweet you to solve technical wahala wey no easy
  • E go good if you sabi: Electronics design
  • E go good if you don contribute to open-source projects

How Di Interview Go Take Waka

  1. Call of 15 Minutes: Quick gist about wetin dey motivate you, whether you go fit join us well, and we go answer di questions wey you get wey no concern tech.
  2. Two Technical/Product Interviews, One Hour Each: We go dig deep inside how you dey take solve problem, wit our CTO and/or our oga solution architect
  3. Meet Di Team, Say Hello: Free-free session so we go see whether your culture and our own go match.

Wetin We Go Give You

  • You go work on XR and spatial computing technology wey dey for front-front
  • You go own technical systems wey dey challenge, wey dey run for real-time
  • Projects wey get plenty technical tins and wey go challenge your brain
  • Place wey dem respect true-true engineering sabi and wey focus on tech (no meeting anyhow, no report wey no make sense)
  • Full freedom to take technical decisions by yourself
